TITLE: Bioluminescent Alien Reef
DESCRIPTION: Raymarches an underwater alien seabed with smooth-blended swaying coral spires, pulsing hollow-bell jellyfish with undulating SDF tendrils, volumetric caustic light shafts from above, and sparkling plankton. Visually special for its translucent cyan-violet-amber subsurface jellyfish glow and deep abyssal atmospheric depth. Controls: speed (swim & drift pace), intensity (bioluminescent gain), current (tentacle & coral sway strength), invert (negative mode), hue_shift (bioluminescent palette), drift XY (camera aim).
